title: Ravens GM says he's 'gutted' by nixed Maxx Crosby trade, was trying to add both him and Trey Hendrickson

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ravens GM says he's 'gutted' by nixed Maxx Crosby trade, was trying to add both him and Trey Hendrickson
sources.description: The Ravens supposedly wanted both Maxx Crosby and Trey Hendrickson, rather than moving on from one to the other.
